verdict: A near-identical rebuild of the Wikipedia main page where only greys and 1-2 px offsets give it away (banner and search borders too dark, section heading text 1-2 px high); cleanly named flex layout, but little reuse beyond the Appearance panel template.

top_defects.what: banner border #a2a9b1 and fill #f8f9fa instead of #dddddd / #f9f9f9 (border visibly darker); search field border #a2a9b1 instead of #72777d (lighter)

top_defects.where: section headings (From today's featured article, Help us improve, Did you know)
top_defects.what: heading text sits about 1-2 CSS px higher inside its 36 px bar; 'In the news' bar and the news list sit about 1-2 px lower than the reference, the main source of the 5-7 meanDiff grid cells
hamburger drawn pure black instead of #202122-grey, search magnifier darker than the reference's grey, bookmark outline heavier/blacker than the reference
four section headings and ~60 link spans repeat the same arbitrary classes (bg-[#cef2e0], text-[#36c], text-[19.2px]) instead of a shared component/template or tokens; 237 arbitrary values
header children, the main page block and the Appearance panel are absolutely positioned; both columns have a fixed h-[700px], so adding content does not grow them
parentheses rendered upright regular instead of italic as in the reference; otherwise family, sizes, weights and wrapping match line for line

strengths: Every paragraph wraps on exactly the same words as the reference in both columns, with correct sizes (16/26 body, 19.2 bold headings, 15.2 and 13.6 banner lines)
Column fills and heading bars use the measured colors (#f5fffa/#cef2e0/#a3bfb1, #f5faff/#cedff2/#a3b0bf), photos correctly cropped and placed with captions
Appearance panel built from a nested data template (groups x options) with real radio rings, and named groups (Header, Tabs, Welcome banner, Columns)
